Hill View Mountains in 3D

Hill View Mountains

About 1,150 acres (464 ha) of granite and bush · near Stanthorpe QLD · summit 976 m

Drag to look around. Pinch or scroll to zoom. Tap an animal to meet it.

Aerial photo © State of Queensland (QImagery), CC BY 4.0; on laptops the 50 cm photo is cleaned up with AI (Real-ESRGAN), which adds believable, not real, detail. Ground heights: Queensland Government LiDAR DEM, CC BY-SA 4.0, and AWS Terrain Tiles around it. Site plan from the 2007 property plan; positions approximate. Island rock: "Lichen Rock" by Rico Cilliers, Poly Haven, CC0. The island and clouds are just for fun: the refuge sits on solid ground in the Granite Belt. All 2,184 species on our list are shown (Atlas of Living Australia records), placed in the kind of spot they live and drawn larger than life so you can find them.
